advice.check_the_form: Please fill in every box, and check the email address — that is where the answer goes.
advice.couldnt_send: That didn't send. Please try again, or ask at the masjid office.
advice.question_sent: Your question is with the imams
advice.answer_by_email: The answer comes back to the email address you gave. Questions are answered in the order they arrive, and some take a few days.
advice.not_taking_written: The masjid is not taking written questions at the moment.
advice.thats_where_the_answer_goes: That is where the answer goes.
advice.subject: What is it about?
alerts.denied: Notifications are turned off for this app in the phone's settings, so nothing can be scheduled. Turn them on there and come back.
alerts.armed: reminders set for the week ahead. They are refreshed each time you open the app.
alerts.notices_note: Announcements from the office — janāzah notices, madrasah closures, Ramadan timings — appear on the Notices tab. Push notifications for those are being set up and will arrive in a later version of the app.
alerts.sub: Be reminded before jamāʿah, with no signal needed.
bukhari.needs_connection: The narrations are fetched from the masjid's site as you open each book, so this one needs a connection. The book list works without one.
collect.certificate_needed: The application needs your BMCC certificate attached, so it opens on the masjid's website. Everything you have read here applies to it.
giving.choose_another_amount: Choose another amount, or use the bank details below
hallhire.one_hall_mon_thu: One hall can only be hired Monday to Thursday. Pick another day, or take two halls.
hallhire.check_the_form: Please choose what you need, a date, and fill in every box.
hallhire.gone: Somebody took that date while this form was open. Please choose another — the calendar has been refreshed.
hallhire.couldnt_send: That didn't send. Please try again, or ring the office on 01204 535 997.
hallhire.date_held: The date is held for you
hallhire.pay_within_thirty: Pay the £100 deposit within thirty minutes and the date is yours. If the deposit is not paid, the hold lapses and the date goes back on the calendar.
hallhire.caretaker_will_call: The caretaker will call you before the day to arrange access.
hallhire.the_caretaker_will_call_you: The caretaker will call you before the day to arrange access, so it must be a number that reaches you.
times.off_timetable: That date is outside the published timetable.
nikah.check_the_form: Please fill in your name, number, a valid email, who you are, and tick the box.
nikah.couldnt_send: That didn't send. Please try again, or ring the office on 01204 535 997 between 5pm and 7pm.
nikah.request_sent: Your request is with the office
nikah.theyll_ring_you: Somebody will ring the number you gave to confirm the date and the time. Nothing is booked until they do.
nikah.pick_a_first_choice: Pick a first choice, and a second if you have one. The masjid needs a fortnight's notice.
nikah.anything_else: Anything else the office should know
nikah.i_agree_privacy: I agree to these details being held by the masjid so that the nikāḥ can be arranged and recorded.
notices.offline: Announcements will appear once you’re back online. Pull down to try again.
notices.empty: Announcements from the masjid will appear here and stay, so a message you swipe away can still be read.
times.maghrib_note: Maghrib jamāʿah is at the beginning time — the masjid prays it as it comes in.
times.whole_year: Every day of 2026, month by month
sysprefs.lang_note: The Urdu, Gujarati and Arabic wording has not yet been checked by a native speaker. Anything not yet translated shows in English rather than as a blank.
sysprefs.sample: “And establish prayer and give zakāh and obey the Messenger — that you may receive mercy.”
qibla.hold_flat: Hold the phone flat and turn until the needle meets the mark.
qibla.no_compass: No compass on this phone — dial is north-up
qibla.turn_until: Turn until the needle meets the mark
qibla.denied: Location is turned off for this app, so the bearing is the one from the masjid. Within Bolton the difference is a fraction of a degree.
qibla.calibrate: A phone compass is thrown off by anything magnetic — a car, a radiator, a metal table. If the needle wanders, move away from it and wave the phone in a figure of eight.
quran.mushaf_sub: pages · needs a connection the first time
portal.body: The portal is where staff take the register and where parents will be able to see attendance and fees. It signs in against the masjid's own records, so it opens on the website rather than inside the app.
portal.still_building: Registers and pupil records are still being built. If you are a parent, the office can answer anything the portal does not yet show.
privacy.body: The app holds your settings — language, text size and which reminders you want — on your phone and nowhere else. Nothing about how you use it is sent anywhere.
privacy.body2: When you send a request to the masjid — a nikāḥ date, a hall booking, a question for the imams — what you type goes to the masjid's own records so the office can answer you. Donations are taken by Stripe; the masjid never sees your card details.
privacy.full: The full notice, including how long each kind of record is kept and how to ask for yours to be deleted, is on the masjid's website.
privacy.delete_my_data: Ask for my data to be deleted
zakat.nisab_is_the_minimum: Nisab is the minimum you must own before zakat is due. It is fixed in gold and silver, so it moves with the price.
zakat.most_scholars_silver: Most scholars prefer the silver standard, because it is lower and so more people qualify to give.
zakat.gsnote: Enter a price per gram above, or the gold and silver you own cannot be valued.
zakat.include_what_you_owe: Include what you owe right now — bills, rent, money borrowed.
zakat.no_zakat_due: No zakat is due on this amount. Ṣadaqah is always welcome.
zakat.disclaimer: This is a guide, not a ruling. Zakat on a business, on a pension, or on property bought to let can be more involved — ask an imam if your situation is not a simple one.
